text:
jess_sales: Heads up — Nimbus Health (pilot account) spiked usage this month and the invoice is way over the pilot cap. Need a fast decision on a goodwill credit.

edward_revenue_ops: How big is the overage and was this a billing mistake or intentional testing?

jess_sales: About $22k over the pilot allowance. They say they ran internal throughput tests that they thought wouldn’t be billed. Our logs show requests from their prod API key.

mike_finance: @billing-bot paste invoice and token audit

billing-bot: Invoice NIM-2026-04 lines:
1) Hosted API usage: $28,500
2) Pilot credit applied: -$5,000
3) Onboarding credit: -$1,500
Net due: $22,000
Token audit: 1.45B tokens in April with a clear peak consistent with load tests.

edward_revenue_ops: Partial credits applied but still sizable remainder. Sales says misunderstanding about sandbox billing.

jess_sales: They were told "pilot environment" but we never promised free load testing. Relationship is important — potential ARR ~400k.

mike_finance: For customer retention we can offer a one-off credit. My recommendation: approve up to $12k without exec sign-off; above that needs CFO/legal.

olivia_legal: If we exceed $5k we should document an exception and add an amendment clarifying future pilot/test billing. I can prepare docs.

jess_sales: Customer asking for full waiver of the overage. They imply churn if not handled.

edward_revenue_ops: Churn risk high. Recommend tying any credit to a short-term commitment and guardrails to prevent recurrence.

mike_finance: I'll approve $12k conditional on a signed 2-month prepaid commitment and adding a billing flag to prevent further accidental tests. Anything beyond $12k needs CFO sign-off.

olivia_legal: I'll draft an amendment and an exception memo and log it in the deal-exceptions ledger.

jess_sales: They verbally agreed to 2mo prepaid if we cover $12k. I'll get it signed.

edward_revenue_ops: I'll add a billing rule to mute billing for keys flagged as sandbox and alert on any prod-key spikes.

mike_finance: Action items: jess_sales secure signed 2mo commit by COB Fri; olivia_legal draft amendment and memo; edward_revenue_ops add billing protections; billing-bot create $12k credit memo.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-NIM-2026-04 created for $12,000. Waiting for amendment upload.

jess_sales: Uploaded signed commitment at 1781269000. Please apply credit.

billing-bot: Applied credit. Updated net due: $10,000. Invoice outstanding balance adjusted. :white_check_mark:

olivia_legal: Amendment draft uploaded to /contracts/drafts/Nimbus_amend_2026.pdf and exception memo recorded.

mike_finance: Approving $12k one-time credit and documenting exception. Monitor for repeat incidents.

jess_sales: Thanks team — customer appeased for now. Closing thread.
